observations.explanation: The paper describes APIBench, AST-based evaluation, Gorilla fine-tuning, and a held-out test set (PDF pp. 2–6). The appendix also reports the data splits (p. 13).

In the zero-shot results, Gorilla exceeds both listed GPT baselines on TorchHub, HuggingFace, and TensorFlow Hub. The paper explicitly notes that HuggingFace uses a different, less stringent check for comparison models (PDF p. 7).
The paper states that, for HuggingFace, models other than Gorilla are checked only for correct domain names, whereas TorchHub and TensorHub use AST-tree accuracy for all models (PDF pp. 6–7).
The paper reports 29.20% accuracy degradation with GPT-Index and 52.27% with BM25 when evaluating the retrieval-aware fine-tuned model, relative to the ground-truth retrieval setting (PDF pp. 7–8).
